# ANTIMICROBIAL SUSCEPTIBILITIES

Antimicrobial selection should be based on likely susceptibilities of

anticipated or proven pathogens. Clinicians should be aware of local, regional,

and national susceptibility patterns. Several sources for susceptibility

patterns are listed below.

[Minneapolis-Antibiogram](https://vhaantimicrobialstewardship.github.io/assets/uploads/001-TestStation/AntibiogramMinneapolis.pdf)
